hypothesis.claim: A streaming materializer can map every and only HARM predictive GSRT2 byte coordinate to the corresponding eight exact MSB-first Endpoint428 Q16 counts in CMX21P1, emit a valid repeated HSP1 stream, and bind the complete truth/probability prefix with a reproducible observational transcript witness without opening corpus or active HORIZON outputs.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject this materializer if either repeat differs, any predictive coordinate or probability differs, a nonpredictive coordinate enters HSP1, the frozen HSP1 parser rejects it, either transcript witness differs from an independent reference, any declared malformed input is accepted, or fixture execution accesses corpus or active HORIZON evidence.

changedMechanism: Add the exact streaming CMX21P1-plus-GSRT2 to HSP1 extraction and transcript-witness bridge; do not change HARM-Delta, Endpoint428, the route population, probability counts, or any scientific gate.
invariants: CMX21P1 is exactly a 16-byte header followed by WRT-bytes times eight little-endian uint16 pretruth P1 counts.
For WRT coordinate c, the eight counts are copied from byte offset 16 + 16*c with no rounding or recomputation and remain in MSB-first truth-bit order.
Only validated GSRT2 event type 3 records in the declared replay interval request parent rows; coordinates are unique and strictly increasing.

The rolling parent transcript witness commits observer identity, trace header, WRT identity and geometry, then every coordinate, postprediction truth, and exact probability row through the replay end.
The transcript witness is observational trajectory evidence and does not claim hidden-state serialization or native P/K synchronization authority.
A/B outputs are independently materialized and must be byte-identical before use.
This gate generates all inputs under its result scratch directory and cannot stat, open, hash, mmap, or inspect canonical corpus or the active HORIZON result namespace.
Corpus use remains forbidden until a new activation-gated experiment binds the exact terminal HORIZON router and complete immutable inputs.
All fixture evidence has zero retained-gain, archive, native-integration, and objective credit.

controls.definition: Materialize HSP1 from generated CMX21P1, WRT, and GSRT2-A.
Independently materialize from the separately generated byte-identical GSRT2-B and require complete HSP1 and receipt identity.
An independent fixture calculation selects expected probability rows and recomputes both transcript boundary digests without calling the materializer.
Ten frozen mutations cover CMX21P1 geometry/domain, GSRT2 geometry/accounting/order/population, WRT identity, and transcript binding; all must fail closed.

population.selection: Four event-type-3 records interleaved with four nonpredictive GSRT2 callbacks over a generated nine-byte WRT transcript and 72 generated CMX21P1 bit rows.
population.coordinate: Zero-based WRT byte coordinate; CMX21P1 rows within each byte are MSB-first coder-bit positions zero through seven.

availableInformation: The frozen GSRT2 record and its pretruth source/availability coordinate.
The truth byte only after its probability row has been selected, solely for the rolling transcript witness.
forbiddenInformation: Current truth when selecting or changing a probability row, future bytes, HARM outcomes, partial gains, controls, or chronological partitions.
Canonical enwiki9, the live parent.p1 file, or any active HORIZON result artifact.
Any edit to Endpoint428, HARM-Delta, GSRT2, HSP1, mixtures, controls, thresholds, or scope definitions.

measurements.definition: Conjunction of every frozen source-fixture predicate.
All and only the four predictive coordinates and all 32 selected Q16 counts equal the independent reference.
Independent A/B HSP1 outputs and normalized receipts are byte-identical.
Both materialized boundary witness digests equal the independent reference calculation.
The immutable measured HSP1 v1 parser accepts each output and reproduces its binding metadata.
Count of prospectively frozen corruptions rejected without installing an output.
Number of sparse parent records emitted in each valid fixture materialization.
Canonical corpus files opened by the source fixture.
Files under the active HORIZON result namespace opened, stated, or hashed by the source fixture.
Maximum resident set size reported for the source-fixture process.
